title: When the Passage Falls
author: Kestrel Dunmore
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
